# Quant Agent: Perhitungan sinyal momentum 12-1m
import numpy as np
def calculate_momentum_12_1(df):
    # Skip return 1 bulan terakhir untuk menghindari short-term reversal
    r_12m = df['close'].pct_change(252)
    r_1m = df['close'].pct_change(21)
    signal = r_12m - r_1m
    return signal.dropna()

print('T-statistic: 2.38 | p-value: 0.0178 (Signifikan pada alpha 5%)')
output:
